priorityList: Ensure Hunter's Mark is active on the target.
Use stat-granting on-use Trinkets right before Bestial Wrath.
Use all Barbed Shot charges right before Bestial Wrath comes off cooldown to maximize cooldown reduction.
Hold a Kill Command charge if Bestial Wrath is coming off cooldown within a few seconds.
Cast Kill Command regardless of the Nature's Ally weaving requirement if Howl of the Pack Leader is ready (ability icon is glowing).
Cast Cobra Shot as a filler.
Cast Kill Command if you are about to reach 2 charges to avoid capping.
Cast Barbed Shot if Frenzy is about to expire on your pet (less than 2 seconds remaining).
Cast Kill Shot whenever Vicious Hunt is active from Pack Coordination.
Cast Kill Command as your primary focus spender and to generate Vicious Hunt stacks.
Cast Barbed Shot if you have 2 charges or a Wild Call proc to reduce the cooldown of Bestial Wrath.
Cast Cobra Shot as a filler when you have excess focus and no other priority abilities are available.
